Committee Minutes · 2026.08.15

Minutes of the meeting of the Strategic Planning Committee held on August 15, 2026

Present
  • Mr. Philicious Derry — The Chairman
  • Ms. Wilhelmina Awusa — Operations Manager
  • Ms. Malorie Tyson — Marketing Manager
  • Mr. Oyeh Ampofo — Head, Finance Manager
  • Ms. Martina Elikem — Outreach Coach
In attendance
  • Mr. Bright Kale — External Consultant
1.0 — Constitution and opening of meeting

The meeting commenced at 11:02 a.m. with an opening prayer led by Mr. Ampofo.

2.0 — Adoption of previous minutes

The minutes of the previous meeting were adopted on a motion moved by Ms. Elikem and duly seconded by Mr. Ampofo.

3.0 — Matters arising

3.1 Update on financing of advertisement campaign. The Marketing Manager reported that the campaign for Product B carried an estimated budget of $10,000, covering social media advertising, radio and television, promotional materials, events and transportation.

The Finance Officer proposed part-financing from company savings, supplemented by a technical partnership with an external vendor to reduce equipment costs, with any shortfall to be sourced through sponsorships, grants or short-term financing.

It was agreed that priority would be given to funding sources and service providers offering competitive rates, flexible payment terms and measurable value, with all proposed expenditure reviewed against the approved budget.

Resolved

The Finance Manager was tasked with preparing a detailed funding plan; the Marketing Manager was tasked with identifying and approaching potential sponsorship partners.

4.0 — Business of the day

No further items were tabled under this heading.

5.0 — Any other business

No other matters were raised.

6.0 — Closing

There being no further business, the Chairman thanked members for their contributions and closed the meeting.
